newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan moves offshore firing range away from Japan.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan moves offshore firing range away from Japan.

text.p: Taiwan's navy has moved an offshore firing practice zone further away from a Japanese island and closer to Taiwan following complaints by Japanese fishermen, defence ministry officials said on Friday.

"We recently moved the navy's firing zone closer to Taiwan in consideration of the working rights and safety of Japanese fishermen and friendly relations with Japan," a ministry spokesman told Reuters.
The navy, in compliance with international law, designated in August 1994 a zone in the sea off Taiwan's northeast coast as a live-fire practice area.
Japanese fishermen have repeatedly complained about drills in the zone, located just 27 km (17 miles) from Japan's Yunaguni island, which lies 110 km (65 miles) from Taiwan's east coast.
Taiwan commanders have decided to move the zone to a site 90 km (56 miles) from the Japanese island, officials said.
